# Veloq

> Veloq is a Pakistani AI software house that builds custom AI solutions, automation systems, and intelligent software products for startups and enterprises. Based in Pakistan, led by Usman Safdar.

## Services

- [Agentic AI Systems](https://veloq.tech/services/agentic-ai): Multi-agent orchestration using LangGraph and custom pipelines. Autonomous systems that reason, plan, and execute across tools and APIs 24/7.
- [RAG & Knowledge Systems](https://veloq.tech/services/rag-knowledge): Retrieval-augmented generation pipelines that turn documents, contracts, and internal data into a queryable AI layer with sub-100ms latency.
- [Full-Stack AI Products](https://veloq.tech/services/fullstack-ai): End-to-end SaaS product engineering — auth, billing, dashboards, and AI built in from day one using Next.js, Supabase, and Vercel.
- [Workflow Automation](https://veloq.tech/services/workflow-automation): Event-driven automation pipelines using n8n and Python that eliminate repetitive manual operations permanently.
- [Voice AI Agents](https://veloq.tech/services/voice-ai): Voice agents built on Retell AI and Deepgram for inbound/outbound calls, appointment booking, and CRM updates with sub-600ms response times.
- [Custom AI Integrations](https://veloq.tech/services/ai-integrations): Injecting AI capabilities into existing CRMs, ERPs, and internal tools via REST, webhooks, OAuth, and GraphQL — no rip-and-replace.

## Tech Stack

LangGraph, OpenAI, Python, AutoGen, Pinecone, LlamaIndex, FastAPI, Next.js, Supabase, Vercel, Stripe, n8n, Zapier, Retell AI, Deepgram, Twilio, REST, GraphQL, Webhooks, OAuth
